seo.title: Managed IT Equipment Storage in Kyiv — IT Asset Logistics
seo.description: Managed storage for corporate IT, reserve and project equipment in Kyiv — from a few sealed boxes to larger batches, with package-level receipt and release.

hero.label: Managed Storage
hero.lead: Corporate equipment storage in Ukraine — without running your own local warehouse.
paragraphs: We receive and store corporate IT, technical, reserve and project equipment at our Kyiv-based facility — from a few sealed boxes to larger equipment batches. We record received and released packages and arrange equipment release on request. Detailed inventory, packing and dispatch coordination are available when needed.
hero.illustration_label: Illustration: sealed boxes and equipment cases with numbered package tags

what_we_store.label: What We Store
what_we_store.title: From corporate IT to project equipment.
what_we_store.intro: We provide managed storage for corporate equipment and technical stock. Our service covers sealed boxes, individual devices, reserve stock and project batches — with the level of inventory detail agreed for each request.

items.title: Corporate IT Equipment
items.text: Laptops, desktop computers, monitors, networking devices, peripherals and other corporate IT hardware.
items.illustration_label: Illustration: a laptop, a monitor and a router

items.title: Reserve & Replacement Stock
items.text: Spare devices, replacement equipment, accessories and technical components held for future use or service requests.
items.illustration_label: Illustration: spare device boxes and a tray of components

items.title: Demonstration & Exhibition Equipment
items.text: Product samples, demonstration units, presentation kits and exhibition equipment stored between events, customer visits or assignments.
items.illustration_label: Illustration: a blank roll-up banner, a sample unit and a presentation case

items.title: Project & Technical Equipment
items.text: Measuring instruments, electronic devices, installation kits and technical equipment held for planned projects or phased deliveries.
items.illustration_label: Illustration: a measuring instrument, a kit case and a cable coil

aside.title: Other equipment? Let’s discuss it.
aside.text: We review storage requests individually, taking into account equipment dimensions, weight, packaging and handling requirements.

services.label: Storage Services
services.title: Straightforward storage. Additional handling when you need it.
services.intro: Whether you have a few factory-sealed boxes or a larger batch of equipment, we provide storage with the level of service that suits your needs.

core.title: Core Storage
core.intro: For clients who simply need a reliable local place to keep their equipment.

items.title: Receiving
items.text: We accept equipment from you, your supplier or a carrier and record the number of packages and the visible condition of their outer packaging.

items.title: Storage
items.text: Your equipment is stored as received, without opening sealed boxes unless otherwise agreed.

items.title: Basic Records
items.text: We maintain records of received and released packages.

items.title: Release on Request
items.text: Your equipment can be released to you or your authorised representative according to agreed instructions.

optional.title: Optional Handling Services
optional.intro: For clients who need [more than storage](/equipment-hub/), additional operations can be arranged:
items: Detailed inventory by item, model or serial number
Preparation of individual items or complete equipment kits

aside.title: Just a few boxes? That’s fine.
aside.text: You don’t need a complex logistics service to store your equipment with us. Start with simple storage and add other services when required.

arrangements.label: Flexible Storage Arrangements
arrangements.title: Storage that fits your requirements.
arrangements.intro: Whether you need to store a few boxes for several months or maintain a larger equipment stock in Ukraine, we can agree on a practical storage arrangement for your business.

items.title: Flexible Volumes
items.text: From a small number of packages to larger equipment batches, subject to available capacity and handling requirements.

items.title: Agreed Storage Periods
items.text: Storage duration and extension terms are agreed according to your requirements.

items.title: Remote Coordination
items.text: Manage storage requests from abroad through an English-speaking local contact, without needing to visit the warehouse.

items.title: Clear Arrangements
items.text: Storage conditions, included services, additional operations and payment terms are agreed in advance.

cta.label: Get in Touch
cta.title: Need equipment storage in Ukraine?
cta.lead: Whether you have a few sealed boxes or a larger batch of equipment, tell us what you need to store.
paragraphs: Share a brief description of your equipment, approximate volumes, expected storage period and any additional handling requirements.
We’ll review your request and discuss a suitable storage arrangement.
